suites.description: Backups and restores are encrypted, integrity-addressed and complete

checks.name: unencrypted or evidence-free backups are rejected
intelligence backup classes are all required
restore is isolated, integrity-checked and dependency-complete
restore under current policy cannot resurrect revoked or invalid state

suites.description: Migrations are dry-run gated and roll back without mixed-version state

checks.name: dry run requires compatibility, preconditions, backup and rollback
failed or uncertain migrations require rollback
partial migration rolls back every applied item and preserves erasure

suites.description: Provider loss degrades or replaces without silent substitution

checks.name: provider health decides keep, degrade or replace
replacement candidates must be available, free and compatible
canonical provider replacement enforces free-first and capability parity

suites.description: Offline shell and updates never fake freshness or mixed versions

checks.name: the PWA shell states its offline limits explicitly
incompatible updates are blocked and rollback restores known-good
stale caches and projection gaps are rejected rather than patched

suites.description: Dormant capabilities reactivate and chaos recovery stays fenced

checks.name: dormant capabilities re-enter the full configure-connect-authorize-enable path
chaos recovery requires fencing, checkpoints and no stale mutation
